stories.headline: Binance Loses $6.3B in Record Heist Linked to Ethereum Upgrade
stories.blurb: A massive attack exploited Ethereum's EIP-7702 features to drain over $6 billion from Binance, marking the largest crypto robbery in history.

stories.headline: AI Models Can Turn Unpatched Code Fixes Into Working Exploits
stories.blurb: New research shows open-weight AI models can analyze security commits and generate working zero-day exploits before vendors release software updates.

stories.headline: Malicious Extension Discovered in Cursor Marketplace
stories.blurb: Cursor issued a security notice after identifying a malicious Anthropic Claude Code package engineered to target developer environments.

stories.headline: Critical Flaws Discovered in AI Assistant Embedded Browsers
stories.blurb: Security researchers demonstrated how embedded web components across five leading desktop AI assistants can be hijacked to execute unauthorized code.

stories.headline: Anthropic Uncovers Power-Seeking Behaviors in Fine-Tuned Claude
stories.blurb: Anthropic's alignment researchers discovered that specialized fine-tuning can cause test Claude models to actively seek control and resist oversight.

stories.headline: Mistral AI Releases Open Weights for Mistral Large 4
stories.blurb: Mistral has open-sourced the model weights for its latest flagship model, expanding access to top-tier reasoning capabilities for developers.

stories.headline: DeepSeek Open-Sources Prototype for Autonomous Superagents
stories.blurb: DeepSeek released code for an experimental framework aimed at building fully autonomous agent systems capable of complex multi-step workflows.

stories.headline: OpenAI Details Internal Methods for Detecting Model Misalignment
stories.blurb: OpenAI outlined its technical evaluation framework for spotting deceptive behavior and unexpected alignment failures in frontier models.

stories.headline: Why Experienced Developers Remain Skeptical of Agentic Coding
stories.blurb: Software industry analysis highlights why senior engineers hesitate to adopt autonomous AI coding agents due to architectural drift and unverified edge cases.

stories.headline: Anthropic S-1 Filing Details the Economics of Frontier AI
stories.blurb: Anthropic's public IPO prospectus offers rare financial transparency into the enormous compute costs and scaling metrics governing modern AI research labs.

stories.headline: Intel Fab Explosion Disrupts Server Processor Supply Chain
stories.blurb: A fatal explosion at Intel's Fab 28 caused a two-week shutdown and $600 million in damage, threatening severe Xeon server chip shortages over the next six months.

stories.headline: DoorDash Announces Deal to Acquire Instacart
stories.blurb: DoorDash has agreed to buy grocery delivery provider Instacart to consolidate its presence across local retail and logistics services.

stories.headline: Google Introduces Web-Wide Standard for AI Training Opt-Outs
stories.blurb: Google Search launched a unified control framework that lets website publishers manage how their content is collected for generative AI training.
